zh: 图像中是一组高而大体竖向排列的深色笔画。
尖状上部笔画包围着一条狭窄的内部线条。
上部向下进入一个带两个浅色开口的圆钝围合区。
一段狭窄笔干把该区域与下方横向笔画相连。
下方横向笔画内有两个浅色开口，并向下伸出竖笔。
外部边缘不规则，两侧宽度并不相同。
en: The image presents a tall, mostly vertical arrangement of dark strokes.
A pointed upper stroke surrounds a narrow inner line.
The upper body descends into a rounded enclosure with two pale openings.
A narrow stem connects that enclosure to a lower horizontal bar.
The lower bar contains two pale openings and a vertical stroke below.
The outer edges are uneven, with different widths on the two sides.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
